newsitem.title: USA: Nemdaco says Larkin, Stearman resign.
newsitem.headline: Nemdaco says Larkin, Stearman resign.

text.p: Nemdaco Inc said that Gary Larkin had resigned as president and director and Sam Stearman resigned as chief financial officer and director.
Their directorship resignations took effect November 1 and the resignations from other duties became effective October 4.

It said both Larkin and Stearman wish to pursue other business opportunities. Anlise Cross, Nemdaco's secretary, will serve out Larkin's unexpired term on the board. Stearman's seat remains vacant until a replacement is found. Thomas Siciliano was named as the new chief financial officer.
A president is expected to be announced Friday, it said.
